The Squire nobly offers protection to his weaker compatriots in battle, fighting off all attackers with his sword.
The Knight uses his divine strength to guard the Empire against iniquity.
The Imperial Knight's absolute faith propels him to defend the innocent, making him a formidable adversary.
The Witch-Hunter is immune to mind based attacks through his experience in battling evil forces.
Long devoted to the task of eradicating evil, the Inquisitor attacks with holy force and is not affected by mind based attacks.
The Archer's attack is swift and far-reaching, making him effective against magic-users that shield themselves behind their stronger comrades.
The Marksman has great skill with the bow; his arrows fly far and a single hit can mean death to his opponents.
The Apprentice unleashes lightning upon all enemy units, he attacks with vengeance from a distance.
Casting lightning with double the violence, the Mage shows no mercy to adversaries.
The Wizard is a peerless spellcaster; he calls down mighty bolts of lightning from the heavens.
As a healer, the Acolyte comes to the aid of one unit at a time in combat.
Priests can substantially heal damaged units. They patiently attend to one soldier at a time during battle.
The Imperial Priest is blessed with the ability to cure units; the wounded will recover much of their health under his individual care.
The Paladin has been granted the best armor in the land to staunchly defend his people against unholy forces.
An emissary of the Highfather, the Angel's holy lance smites all those who threaten the Empire.
The Cleric brings down divine aid to heal all injured in her party.
The Matriarch's prayers miraculously heal all in her party.
The Titan is an immense, stalwart creature; she towers far above enemy armies.
The Pegasus Knight is a noble fighter whose winged steed carries him high above forests and sea.
Traveling quickly around the realm, the Ranger is often sent on scouting missions by the King.
Master of the arcane, an Archmage is the only Empire leader who can use staffs and scrolls.
The Archangel claims land for the Empire by planting rods. The ground surrounding her rods magically converts into Empire soil.
Thieves are adept at mischief, and can sneak behind enemy lines to secure information important to the Empire's cause.
A powerful suit of armor come to life. It wields a mighty blade, destined to slay all foes.
The enchanted form of the earth Golem obeys its maker; it will stop only when its lifeless body is reduced to dust.
The Axe Thrower's great strength and ferocious fighting spirit allows it to reach any unit during battle.
Crossbowmen rain death upon their adversaries with each volley.
Flinging fire into the fray, the Flame Caster's attack reaches all members of the enemy party.
The Hill Giant possesses strength so great that it chooses an uprooted tree as its weapon.
The massive Rock Giant hurls giant boulders at its foe.
They descend from the skies to bring lightning storms down on all those who offend the Dwarves.
The Ice Giant is called from frigid mountain peaks to fight for the clan's cause.
The Tenderfoot's gentle arts increase the force of her allies in battle.
The magical potions of the Novice increase the damage of one unit in battle.
The Druidess is an adept who cures her allies and can magically add to the force of their weapon.
The Dwarf rushes valiantly into battle, knowing that Wotan protects the brave of heart.
The Warrior is always ready to battle for the glory of his God, Wotan.
The Veteran has meted out justice to many. He desires to one day die with honor in battle.
Dwarves rewarded for unusual skill in battle by being named King of their Clan. Dwarf Kings wear the finest dwarven armor.
Dwarves who have seen many years of battle, Venerable Warriors fight with the ferocity of those who have no fear of the world beyond.
Well adapted to hostile climes, the Mountaineer showers entire armies with icy shards culled from mountain glaciers.
Polar Bears reside in the snow-laden mountaintops of the realm; they defend against those who invade their territory.
With a thick hide and icy breath, the Yeti has sent many an adventurer to an early grave.
As warlike leaders, the King's Guards are sent to quell any danger that threatens the dwarven lands.
Engineers travel far and wide, keeping the High King informed of happenings in the Dwarven Lands.
The Loremaster collects the ancestral wisdom of the Clans and has the ability to use staffs and scrolls.
Chosen by Wotan to transform the land, the Dwarf Champion plants rods to expand the High King's territory.
A Thief has many tricks at his disposal that he employs to further the High King's cause.
Rocs are giant birds called down from the mountains to fight alongside the Clans in times of war.
Hovering near battlefields to collect the fallen, these women warriors are fearsome when crossed.
These statues are animated by the souls of fierce warriors of old.
The Demon Lord enslaves these strong-bodied peasants to fight in his infernal battles.
As humanity weakens in these possessed creatures, their violence becomes uncontrollable.
Demons have mastered the souls of these once holy warriors, their virtuous past has long been forgotten.
Those who obey blindly the orders of cruel leaders become stone demons in the afterlife; They suffer in infernal fires, and turn slowly to stone.
Marble Gargoyles are the winged demons of the sixth plane of hell; they are impervious to mind attacks and their bodies are too solid to be easily damaged.
This unclean being menaces the land for his dark Lord Bethrezen.
Demons inhabit the lower regions of Hell, they are more powerful than the lesser devils.
Molochs gain power and strength by devouring the souls of those they slay.
The great Beast the very form of maleficence, none can escape the reach of this monstrosity.
The Demon Lord is a sovereign of Hell; As such, they lead devilish armies for Bethrezen.
Humans that have an inborn affinity for evil; they call down fire on entire armies.
Dark Sorcerers can summon fiery rain to consume enemy forces.
The Demonologist creates a storm of Flames so powerful that no army can escape it.
The Incubus turns men to stone with his horrible death cries.
The Pandemoneous controls infernal fires, incinerating entire armies at once.
Witches dwell in the depths of forests; if bothered they have been known to retaliate by transforming the hated interlopers.
Hags have the ability to transform enemies into anything they desire.
The Fiend hides its misshapen form within a labyrinthine lair. Few can resist its furious attack.
The Duke's warlike spirit leads demons into battle, sword in hand.
The Counselor leads the vanguard of the Legions forces; he travels at high speed upon the lands.
The Archdevil is master of the arcane; he has knowledge of staffs and scrolls.
Under the Baroness' control the realm transforms into a fiery wasteland.
The Thief is valued for his skill in subterfuge.
The Three-headed Cerebus guards Hell's denizens with his fiery breath.
The huge Beliarh demon skewers opponents with its humongous horns.
The Avenger lives to punish those who doubt the authority of Bethrezen, ruler of hell.
Ghosts are spirits bound by evil to the earth; they join their undead brethren's crusade.
A Specter's forceful spirit makes her paralyzing attack stronger.
Initiates have been trained to spread death and disease upon living armies.
Warlocks become more effective over time in their quest to spread pestilence on the lands.
The Necromancer has perfected his craft; pestilence will engulf any army he encounters.
Men who have rejected the words of the Highfather become vampires. They sustain themselves by draining the life force of innocents.
Those who cultivate arcane knowledge in life become Liches; they infect the living with deadly plague winds.
Wraiths pass over from the land of the undead to spread pestilence.
These Fighters live again to crush the enemies of Mortis.
Dead souls who have been transformed by ritual into mindless Zombies.
The Skeleton Warrior is compelled by the will of Mortis to fight alongside the Undead.
Great fighting unit of the undead, the Skeleton Champion raises his bony fists against the living.
Templars subvert religious rites in order to honor Queen Mortis. They are impervious to the elements.
Mortis grants the Dark Lords control over the elements as reward for their servitude.
The werewolf rampages by moonlight; He cannot be killed by any blade.
Sorcerers resurrect lifeless dragons, creating Wyverns to fight in their Undead armies.
These awesome beasts breathed fire while living; now undead, they exhale poisonous vapors on enemy troops.
Deathdragons terrorize the land from beyond the grave; their poisonous breath envelops entire armies during battle.
The Death Knight's ferocity in battle is unmatched. His great strength and flying ability are his greatest assets.
Nosferats drain the life force of their enemies in battle, weakening opponents while feeding thier own evil souls.
Female Necromancers live after death as the dreadful Lich Queen. Their unholy knowledge allows them to use staffs and scrolls.
Banshees plant rods on living soil and create from it a barren wasteland.
A Thief is sent by the king to enemy cities. There he uses his craft to outwit the enemy.
Frail skeletons magically animated and used by the Undead as scouts.
Evil Ents are brought from the undead world through dark ceremony.
Crazy creatures called from the imagination of dark sorcerers, Nightmares brings death to Mortis' enemies.
Death comes forth by Mortis' command to fell the mortal armies of the Earth.
The Hellhound rushes into combat, spewing forth fire. Its illusory nature makes it immune to magic attacks.
The Beliarh is a horned menace summoned to fight Mortis' enemies.
The Avenger is a fiery creature whose flames scorch entire armies.
Elves have long used Griffins as mounts, but even alone they prove fearsome adversaries.
Barbarian tribes hail from the Northern Steppes, The Chieftain urges his warriors to go forth in search of treasure.
Peasants defend the little turf that they can call home.
The Mythological Red Dragon can be found near lava pits and volcanoes. Some say that they can live up to 4000 years
Lizard men are the strange offspring of the marshlands; they are said to be particularly fond of human flesh.
The Medusa is a solitary creature; she petrifies those who come too close with her gaze.
Ogres are thick-skulled warriors; they attack all comers without guile or stratagem.
Thugs assemble in bands to steal from unwary travelers and feeble peasants.
Forest Elves move swiftly, surveying the frontiers and alerting their people of any intruders.
The Oracle Elf is gifted in the use of the healing arts. The Elven gods chose these beings as their representatives.
Trolls are exceedingly strong and resistant to attack, having the ability to regenerate each day.
The Mermaid paralyzes victims with its dazzling song, then feasts on the living flesh.
Orc Champions lead greenskin armies in battle. Only orc's of the "Large Mouth" type can aspire to this position.
Goblins are distant relations of the orc family. They are not strong creatures, but are limber and cunning.
Centaurs are hotheaded fighters who will defend against any army.
Orcs of "Small mouth" status are used in the front lines of battle, being of tough build.
Mercenaries who make their mighty services available to all, for a price.
The Elf Lord staunchly defends his people by summoning powerful storms.
The Elf Ranger flings arrows at the enemy, and is able to attack from any distance.
The Spearman will fight ferociously for whomever offers the most coin.
Ghouls are dangerous undead creatures; they attack those who come across them with tricks of the mind.
Demons send the ignoble Imp on errands of mischief in the realm.
The mythological White Dragon is a rare and beauteous sight. Some say that they live up to 3000 years
The mythological Blue Dragon makes its home near water. Some say that they live up to 3000 years
The mythological Black Dragon lives deep in the wastelands. Some say that they live up to 4000 years
The mythological Green Dragon camouflages itself in forests. Some say that they live up to 3000 years.
The most majestic of Griffins, skylords fight alongside the Elven race.
The Giant Spiders' venom is poisonous; They agressively pursue any enemy they detect.
A grave danger while at sea, the Sea serpent has defeated many a great war vessel.
A natural enemy of the Sea Serpent, the Kraken attacks seafarers that venture too close to its watery lair.
Orc Kings seize the throne by challenging their King to a fight to the death, making them the strongest of their kind.
Centaur lancers are lovers of forestlands, they are not afraid to protect their forests from any foe.

Vithar the mighty is seated at the right of Wotan on his eternal feast table. He has been ordered to guard the capital, never to leave it.

Ashgan, bringer of plagues, was an Alkmaar high priest. He was ordered by Mortis to never leave the capital unprotected.
The Merman lies in wait of lost sailors, capturing and devouring the defenseless at sea.

The Hierophant's devotion is such that he can revive dead warriors through ceremony.
The Prophetess is able to commune directly with the Highfather, her illumined word cures her comrades in battle.
White Wizards use pure magic to help the Highfather's followers.
Elementalists have mastered the winds, so to summon forth airy beasts in battle.
The Imperial Assassin makes use of dark arts to kill its enemies.
The Holy Avenger is consumed by his earthly mission to fight evil.
The Defender of Faith guards against the profane beings that would fight the Highfather.
The Grand Inquisitor has withstood the fires and the terrors of Hell itself to oust evil influences from the realm.
The most ancient of Dwarven warriors are the Elder Ones; they have learned well the art of war.
Descended from the greatest Dwarven warrior that ever lived, Sons of Ymir can kill with a single blow.
The Archdruidess administers tonics to her warriors, which allows them to smite enemies with greater force.
Alchemists charm their allies, thereby granting them an extra attack during battle.
The Forge Guardian crafts his own weapons with care; his crossbow bolts are devastating.
The Hermit masters the horn of war; gathering the Clans against invaders.
The Wolf Lord has dominion over the spirits of wolves, he can call upon their powers in battle.
The Runemaster is a fearsome warrior; he imbues his axe with runic magic.
Knights that once fought for the Highfather; Their souls have been corrupted to Bethrezen's purpose. They learned to regenerate their wounds as Empire cohorts.
Hardened by the fires of hell, the Onyx Gargoyle is a threat to enemies of Bethrezen.
Attached to Bethrezen's hellish throne, Tiamath is only released during Bethrezen's demented frenzies.
Overlords control the most unruly inhabitants of hell; occasionally they are needed aboveground.
Abyssal Devils emerge from the depths of hell but rarely. Their appearance can make cowards of the most experienced of warriors.
A Doppelganger has the unnatural ability to shape its form, thereby confusing his foe.
Drawing strength from the fires of hell, Modeus wreaks fiery havoc on his enemies.
Succubi are demons who cling still to pleasures of mortals. They can transform their opponents into anything they so wish.
The Shade's horrifying appearance inspires a paralyzing fear in all.
Elder Vampires cheat death by stealing the life essence of mortals.
A sorcerer who prolongs his arcane studies far beyond his mortal lifetime becomes an archlich.
The avatar and messenger of death, gathering souls in the land of the living.
These traitorous warriors prey upon the living as dreadful Wights.
Warriors who betrayed their comrades in battle are condemned to fight forevermore.
The Dreadwyrm is summoned up to rain poisonous malice upon the land.
This great undead dragon pours death down on its enemies.
Goblin archers accompany their fellows in ambushes and attacks, using crude arrows to wound their combatants.
Master thugs lead wandering bands of thieves, they can craft poison elixirs.
Uther is the lost heir of the Empire. Bethrezen returns to Nevendaar in the form of this young boy.
Completely transformed, Demonic Uther knows no fear and will crush whoever stands before his ambitions.
The Air Elemental serves Elementalists who call them down from the planes of air.
Imp servants of the higher infernal planes; these creatures are used by demons to disrupt order in the realm.
Distant parent of the Emperor, Hubert's ambition is to take over the throne and command the Empire.
Daughter of the Clan Cloudkeeper, Yataa'Halli is a skillful warrior and a cautious diplomat.
The Wyrm Nhiddog heralds the coming of Ragnarok: the twilight of the Gods. The enchanted Wyrm's touch enfeebles its opponent, draining them of needed strength.
A mage well versed in the art of magic, he knows the secrets of the ancestral runes.
Master of death ceremonies, Erhog feeds only upon human flesh hoping to gain immortality.
Once a noble Elf, Lyf's crimes resulted in his exile and he became something far more sinister.
Commander of eighty infernal cohorts, Asteroth is feared by all, for he strikes mercilessly allies and enemies alike.
Isolated tribes of Giants that have few encounters with other species.
Novice of an obscure death cult, the Occultist can call upon the dead to serve his dark masters.
Master of the death cult of Nygraal, he calls and commands death spirits at will.
King of a Dwarven Clan, his deeds are renowned and honored across the tribes.
A Mythological beast, the Manticore was thought to exist only in legends.
Armor created by Mortis herself; its wearer acquires great strength and eternal life, but must appease the armor with fresh blood.
Ruler of the Elven kind, the Elf Queen Taladrielle Liilem protects her brothers with the aid of her dragon mount.
